items.verse: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
items.verseEn: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"

items.verse: إِذْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ
items.verseEn: When We inspired to your mother what We inspired,

items.verse: فَإِن طَلَّقَهَا فَلَا تَحِلُّ لَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدُ حَتَّىٰ تَنكِحَ زَوْجًا غَيْرَهُۥ ۗ فَإِن طَلَّقَهَا فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِمَآ أَن يَتَرَاجَعَآ إِن ظَنَّآ أَن يُقِيمَا حُدُودَ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِ يُبَيِّنُهَا لِقَوْمٍۢ يَعْلَمُونَ
items.verseEn: And if he has divorced her [for the third time], then she is not lawful to him afterward until [after] she marries a husband other than him. And if he [i.e., the latter husband] divorces her [or dies], there is no blame upon them [i.e., the woman and her former husband] for returning to each other if they think that they can keep [within] the limits of Allāh. These are the limits of Allāh, which He makes clear to a people who know [i.e.,understand].

items.verse: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَدًۭا ۗ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ ۖ بَل لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ كُلٌّۭ لَّهُۥ قَـٰنِتُونَ
items.verseEn: They say, "Allāh has taken a son." Exalted is He! Rather, to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. All are devoutly obedient to Him,

categories.name: قِصَّةُ يُونُسَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ فِي سُورَةِ الصَّافَّاتِ
categories.nameEn: Story of Prophet Yunus in Surah As-Saffat

items.verseEn: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.
And he drew lots and was among the losers.
And had he not been of those who exalt Allāh,

items.verse: لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
items.verseEn: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected.

categories.name: مُفرَدَاتُ المُقَرَّبِينَ فِي سُورَةِ الوَاقِعَةِ
categories.nameEn: Key Terms for the Foremost in Surah Al-Waqi'ah

items.verseEn: Those are the ones brought near [to Allāh]
A [large] company of the former peoples
And a few of the later peoples,

categories.name: ثَوَابُ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي سُورَةِ الْمُرْسَلَاتِ
categories.nameEn: Rewards of the Pious in Surah Al-Mursalat

items.verseEn: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs
And fruits from whatever they desire,

items.verse: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
items.verseEn: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

harf.hint: Crookedness or distortion; what disbelievers try to introduce into God's straight way.
harf.arabicVerse: ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَحِبُّونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا عَلَى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ
harf.verse: 14:3 - The ones who prefer the worldly life over the Hereafter and avert [people] from the way of Allāh, seeking to make it [seem] deviant. Those are in extreme error.

deduction.title: The Splendor That Sank
deduction.intro: Picture this: a soul draped in fine garments and surrounded by treasures beyond imagination. This individual believed their wealth was earned through their own brilliance, never acknowledging the source of true provision. Walking among the followers of a mighty prophet, this person refused every call to humility. Today, we uncover the identity of a figure whose magnificent fortune became their final resting place.
clues: I lived during the time of a prophet who called a stubborn nation to truth.
I was part of a chosen community, yet my heart turned away from the message.
Gold and silver captivated me more than any divine command.
My treasure vaults grew so vast that a strong group of men could barely lift the keys.
I boasted that my wealth was given to me because of my own knowledge.
In the end, I and my entire dwelling were swallowed by the earth as a warning.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: Qarun
Haman
Samiri
Bilqis
Talut (Saul)

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Arrogance over wealth and refusing charity
Forging a golden idol from melted jewelry
Declaring divinity over a powerful kingdom
Persecuting early believers in Makkah
Leading a campaign to destroy the Sacred House
trial.answer: Arrogance over wealth and refusing charity

location.label: Key Element
options: Treasures whose keys burdened many strong men
A golden calf that produced sound
A glorious throne from a distant land
A trench filled with blazing fire
A mighty army of war elephants
location.answer: Treasures whose keys burdened many strong men

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Swallowed by the earth along with the dwelling
Drowned in the sea with an army
Burned alive in a pit of fire
Destroyed by a howling, raging wind
Struck down by a single mighty blast
outcome.answer: Swallowed by the earth along with the dwelling

deduction.arabic: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فِى زِينَتِهِۦ ۖ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا يَـٰلَيْتَ لَنَا مِثْلَ مَآ أُوتِىَ قَـٰرُونُ إِنَّهُۥ لَذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍۢ
deduction.verse: So he came out before his people in his adornment. Those who desired the worldly life said, "Oh, would that we had like what was given to Qārūn. Indeed, he is one of great fortune." (28:79)

scramble.hint: A famous prophetic du'a from Ibrahim (Abraham) seeking forgiveness for himself, his parents, and all believers on the Day of Judgment.
scramble.arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْحِسَابُ
scramble.verseEn: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established."
